messages.subject: reference group for DTF
parts:
Hi Phil,

I'm using the DTF function and am wondering how it selects the reference group with various coding schemes of the grouping variable. For example, if the grouping variable is coded 0 and 1, then 0 will be the reference group correct and 1 will be the focal group? If the grouping variable is coded 1 and 2, which group is selected as the reference? I'm specifically thinking of the sDTF plots and interpreting which group the sDTF is relative to (i.e., which group is the red line in the plot).

Finally, is there a quick way to change the reference in the DTF function?  I looked through the mirt manual but couldn't find any info on this.

Thanks!
Keri

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: reference group for DTF
parts:
Hi Keri,

The group input is changed to a factor internally if it was not one already, where the levels of factor dictate the group ordering (first level = reference). If you want it to be something other than the ordering determined by factor(group) then just change group to a ordered factor first and pass that instead. HTH.

Phil
